citation: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026, Section 14: Children and Adolescents
claim: After initial examination in youth with T1D, repeat dilated/comprehensive eye exam or retinal photography every 2 years; less frequent intervals may be acceptable on eye-care professional advice and risk assessment.
